test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 5 boys R, M, N, B and C are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Only B and R are to the left of M. N is to the immediate right of M. R is not at the ends of the row. Who is sitting to the right of N?
solution:
**Given: **5 boys R, M, N, B and C are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). 

1. Only B and R are to the left of M. 

2. N is to the immediate right of M. 

3. R is not at the ends of the row. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22249304a6fbcd4070c9260b46fa0ace3d8b88971e3d99a37747ff22bf74057d.png] 

C, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b607cbc6058eb05729db30ef5c84bd4a14c2f6a10f60a87155cd6baed611848.png] 

Thus, C is sitting to the right of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
